magicLink.subject: Your link to sign in to Spleen
magicLink.preview: One click, and the turntable spins again.

magicLink.fallback: If the button does not work, paste this link into your browser:
magicLink.ignore: Did not ask for this? Just ignore this email.

auth.title: Step into the club
auth.subtitle: No password: we send you a magic link.
auth.sentBody: A link is on its way to {email}. It is valid for 15 minutes.
auth.devHint: In development, the link is printed in the server terminal.
auth.linkExpired: This link has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
auth.error: That did not work. Try again in a moment.
auth.rateLimited: Too many requests at once. Wait a few minutes.

welcome.title: Welcome to the club
welcome.subtitle: Pick your @username: it is the address of your shelf.
welcome.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, digits, dots and underscores.
welcome.displayNameHint: You can change it whenever you like.
welcome.ageHint: This is the minimum age to use Spleen.

settings.title: Settings
settings.blindModeHint: Hides the community average until you have rated.
settings.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. We crop it to a square.
settings.usernameNote: One change every 30 days at most. Your former username stays reserved for 30 days, then it becomes free again.
settings.exportBody: A JSON file with everything Spleen keeps about you.
settings.deleteBody: Everything goes: profile, diary, reviews, lists and follows. This is permanent. Your username stays reserved for 30 days, with no link to you, then it becomes free again.
